from_value.display_value: guarded recessed one-handed press-hold; no response terminates routine event

to_value.display_value: side-flush guarded recessed press-hold with raised front/back shoulders; 650 ms hold target; no response terminates routine event

rationale: tighten the stop path into a measurable one-handed control without making routine interaction public or two-handed
expected_effect: reduce incidental handrail/bag activation while preserving a reachable local stop path in one-hand-available phases
verification: measure completion rate, completion time, false activations during handrail and bag-carry tasks, and failure reason coding
